BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Filrocas!!
I worked very hard to put up that net.\nIt won't be destroyed easily!
Ughh?!
My name is Galaben the Imperial Dragon...
That light is also important to us dragons.\nDisrespectful behavior is unforgivable!!\nHey you there, give me a hand!!
You think you've won? How foolish!
W-what's that?!
Sorry we came late.\nWe finally caught up with you after defeating\nthose Coenubia monsters...
The cocoon...Oh, thank god it's okay.
I-I wonder what a high-ranking dragon is doing in\nthe Weredragons' Vital Point...
Relax, I don't feel like fighting you now...\nYou don't wanna damage this sacred place either,\ndo you?
You mentioned earlier that the light emitted by\nthat thing is important to dragons too...
Why is the light of the royal dragon cocoon\nimportant to you?!
Let me correct you. That light-emitting thing is\nnot a royal dragon cocoon, it's just something\nthat nurtures and powers the cocoon to hatch...
S-so, where exactly is the royal dragon cocoon...
You'll know one day...\nI won't forgive the Coenubias that are disrupting\nthe resurrection of the royal dragon either...
Anyway, the Coenubia that separated itself from\nthe monster earlier seems to be heading to the\nplace receiving and using the power from here.
The place that is receiving and using the power\nfrom here???
Don't tell me it's...the propulsion system?! \nThat's bad!!
Wait, you're not going to chase the Coenubia?
The thing that was a threat to this place is\ngone...I don't care where the Coenubia has flown\nto or what it's gonna do...
What the...? Ugh! You're getting on my nerves!!
We'll prolly run into each other again...\nI'm looking forward to it.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back for now!
Explore this place a little longer!
